research_strategies.name: Range mean reversion: ADX < 20, RSI overbought, short (perp, 1h, 5 screened coins)
research_strategies.description: Batch study 2026-09-23: ADX low (choppy) triggers overbought; limit order 0.25 ATR above the close (maker), take-profit at the Bollinger mid-band, stop-loss 2 ATR, max hold 30 bars. Asset pool: SOLUSDT/DOGEUSDT/UNIUSDT/BNBUSDT/ADAUSDT selected from the training segment; validation segment 35 trades, expectancy per trade after costs 0.4%, return 2.4% (exposure-matched buy & hold 1.2%, 2x the fee rate 1.9%), annualized Sharpe 0.85; Deflated Sharpe (validation segment, 388 trials) 0.00. Status: draft, needs manual confirmation before moving to paper.

research_strategies.name: BTC 4h trend: EMA50/200 with volatility-target sizing (spot, long)
research_strategies.description: Batch study 2026-09-23: enter when EMA50 is above EMA200, exit on cross-back, ATR×3 catastrophic stop, 50% annualized volatility-target sizing. Asset pool: 9 coins; validation segment 116 trades, expectancy per trade after costs 9.2%, return 123.7% (exposure-matched buy & hold 40.5%, 2x the fee rate 119.5%), annualized Sharpe 1.35; Deflated Sharpe (validation segment, 388 trials) 0.00. Volatility-target sizing is only applied at the batch level; the strategy object is backtested at unit size. Status: draft, needs manual confirmation before moving to paper.

research_strategies.name: EMA20/50 golden cross long, exit on death cross
research_strategies.description: Daily EMA20 crossing above EMA50 (golden cross) triggers a long on that bar, filled at the next bar's open; hold until EMA20 crosses below EMA50 (death cross) to exit. Expected holding period is a few days to a few weeks (trend-continuation horizon, unverified hypothesis); signal frequency is roughly tens of times per 1000 bars (unverified). User didn't specify stop-loss or take-profit, so defaults apply: stop-loss = support break, take-profit = resistance above, structure_target.
